title: La Fanfare des Monstres
description: Four paper-cut monsters want to form an orchestra. Hit D F J K (or tap the lanes) as each note reaches its pad: every good hit plays the monster's instrument, chains raise the multiplier and wake the audience. Three hand-written pieces, an Easy mode, medals at 60/75/90% accuracy — the concert succeeds above 60%.
controls: D F J K: play the four monsters
